Spain.editorial_overview_title: Spain: the exclusive real estate market
Spain.editorial_overview_p1: Spain holds a consolidated position among the preferred destinations for the international high-net-worth buyer. The combination of a stable European legal framework, world-class service infrastructure, and an unparalleled geographic diversity in the western Mediterranean explains the sustained demand recorded in the exclusive residential segment along its coastlines and major cities.
Spain.editorial_overview_p2: The Spanish market attracts differentiated buyer profiles. On one hand, the acquisition of second homes by European buyers, primarily from Northern Europe and the United Kingdom, who prioritise quality of life with direct connections to their home countries. On the other, Latin American and Middle Eastern investors who see Spain as a gateway to Europe, with exposure to a mature and liquid real estate market.
Spain.editorial_overview_p3: Across all of Spain's exclusive markets, the supply of truly exclusive product — oceanfront villas, beachfront penthouses, new builds with premium specifications — presents a structural scarcity that sustains long-term demand.
Spain.editorial_sol_body: The Costa del Sol concentrates the highest volume of premium transactions on the Spanish coastline. Marbella, Benahavís and Estepona form the epicentre, combining high-end new development projects, established golf complexes, and a service infrastructure — marina, gastronomy, international education — that matches the level of residential supply. Demand comes primarily from buyers from Northern Europe, the United Kingdom and the Middle East.
Spain.editorial_blanca_body: The Costa Blanca offers a broad spectrum within the exclusive segment. The north — Jávea, Moraira, Altea — attracts European buyers who value privacy and natural surroundings over service concentration. The south presents greater product diversity and accessibility, with beachfront properties whose entry price is comparatively lower than the Costa del Sol, creating opportunities for investors with a medium-term outlook.
Spain.editorial_cataluna_body: Barcelona maintains active demand in the highest segments of the urban market, driven by international buyers attracted by its economic and cultural dimension. On the coastline, the Costa Brava — with Begur, Cadaqués and Palafrugell as reference points — offers a segment with restricted supply: singular properties with a scarcity of new product, factors that the long-term buyer explicitly values.
Spain.editorial_baleares_body: The archipelago operates in a category of its own. Environmental protection regulations limit the land available for development, generating sustained pressure on existing stock. Ibiza concentrates the most international and highest-purchasing-power profile in the Mediterranean; Mallorca presents a more diversified market, from family buyers to institutional investors; Menorca stands out for its discretion and the preservation of an exceptional natural environment.
Spain.editorial_luz_body: The Costa de la Luz, with Sotogrande as the historic benchmark in the province of Cádiz, offers a segment characterised by lower development pressure than the Mediterranean coastline. Estates with large plots, singular properties, and polo, golf and nautical developments maintain their appeal for buyers who prioritise exclusivity and privacy over service concentration.
Spain.editorial_legal_p1: The acquisition of property in Spain by foreign nationals is not subject to nationality restrictions in the free market. The process requires obtaining a Foreigner's Identification Number (NIE) beforehand, which can be arranged at the Spanish consulate in your country of residence or directly on Spanish territory.
Spain.editorial_legal_p2: The taxation of the purchase varies depending on the type of property: new builds are subject to VAT (at 10% for residential use) plus Stamp Duty; second-hand properties are subject to Transfer Tax, the rate of which varies by autonomous community.
Spain.editorial_legal_p3_prefix: the Golden Visa programme for property investment was repealed by Organic Law 1/2025, in force since April 2025. For non-EU buyers who sought residency through this route, alternatives exist — Investor Visa for business projects, Digital Nomad Visa, non-lucrative residence permit — that a specialist legal adviser can evaluate on a case-by-case basis.
Spain.editorial_legal_p3_link: A detailed analysis is available in our article on the Spain Golden Visa 2026.
Spain.editorial_legal_disclaimer: The information in this section is general and informational in nature. It does not constitute tax or legal advice. For specific transactions, please consult a lawyer specialised in Spanish real estate law.
Spain.editorial_why_intro: Beyond market conditions, Spain offers structural factors that explain the loyalty of international buyers to the destination:
Spain.editorial_why_connectivity_body: The airports of Madrid, Barcelona, Málaga, Palma de Mallorca and Alicante operate direct routes to the main European and transatlantic destinations, with frequencies that allow managing an international agenda without mobility constraints.
Spain.editorial_why_legal_body: As a member state of the European Union, Spain offers a property rights protection framework aligned with continental market standards and a well-established land registry system.
Spain.editorial_why_infra_body: The major exclusive areas boast a network of international schools, private clinics, marinas, reference golf courses and high-level restaurants that allow an uncompromising standard of living.
Spain.editorial_why_community_body: Spain's major exclusive destinations have had established communities of foreign residents for decades, significantly reducing the adaptation curve for new international buyers.

About.intro: We are an international property consultancy specialising in the purchase and sale of homes and assets in the world’s most attractive markets.

Over that time we have advised on more than 1,500 property transactions, from residential homes to commercial and investment assets.
About.mission_p2: At Assets Golden International we connect investors, buyers and sellers with the best opportunities in the global property market. Our partner network across 13 countries lets us offer a comprehensive service tailored to each client profile.
About.mission_p3: We operate in Spain, Mexico, Indonesia, the United Arab Emirates, Argentina, Brazil, the United States, Costa Rica, the Dominican Republic, the United Kingdom, Ecuador, Greece and Paraguay. We continually open new markets in search of better, more profitable opportunities for our clients.
About.network_p: Our partner network covers the leading property markets of Europe, the Americas and the Middle East. That global presence lets us offer clients unique opportunities and access to exclusive properties outside the conventional market.
About.partners_p: We have a consolidated network of agents and partners across 13 countries, allowing us to offer exclusive opportunities and access to high-profile buyers and investors anywhere in the world.

Services.faq1_q: What types of property does Assets Golden handle?
Services.faq1_a: We work with flats and apartments, commercial premises, buildings, plots and land, hotels and hospitality assets, and country estates. Every transaction includes full legal due diligence.
Services.faq2_q: Which countries does Assets Golden operate in?
Services.faq2_a: We are present in 13 countries through our partner network: Spain, Mexico, Indonesia (Bali), the United Arab Emirates (Dubai), Argentina, Brazil, the United States, Costa Rica, the Dominican Republic, the United Kingdom, Ecuador, Greece and Paraguay. We open new markets on an ongoing basis.
Services.faq3_q: Do you work with foreign buyers and investors?
Services.faq3_a: Yes. We provide complete international advisory — tax, legal and practical — for investing in Spain and other European and American markets. We assist in Spanish and English.
Services.faq4_q: What is an off-market property and why does it matter?
Services.faq4_a: These are properties not listed on the usual portals. Through our exclusive network we access these assets discreetly, often before they reach the open market.
Services.faq5_q: Do you offer due diligence and legal support?
Services.faq5_a: Yes. We carry out full due diligence on every transaction and support you through negotiation, financing and post-sale management.
Services.faq6_q: How do I request a consultation?
Services.faq6_a: Tell us about your project from the contact page and we will assign the right specialist. The initial consultation is free and without obligation.
